data.standardized_narrative: Using the syndicate's gross claims development table, prior-year (2017 and earlier) gross claims estimates moved adversely by $36.245m (a 5.9% strengthening relative to opening gross reserves of $617.778m). The movement was identified from the gross claims development triangle (no explicit narrative quantifying a gross prior-year movement was provided). No specific catastrophe or named events were cited as the driver in the disclosed notes.
raw_causal_phrases: there is always a risk that the assumptions and techniques used in these models are unreliable or that claims arising from an unmodelled event are greater than those arising from a modelled event.
variation in interest rates, delays in settlement and changes in foreign currency rates

Claims incurred represent the cost of claims and settlement expenses paid during the financial year, together with the movement in provisions for outstanding claims and claims incurred but not reported ('IBNR').
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) because the report does not present an explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line or a verbatim narrative quantifying a gross prior-year movement. Amounts in the accounts are presented in thousands (report headings $'000); reported numeric fields above are converted to millions (native currency USD). No RITC or named catastrophe events affecting prior years were identified in the provided notes. Mapping of 'MGA Insurance' to a standard Lloyd's LOB was not explicit; 'MGA Insurance' and 'Reinsurance' are used from the divisional summary (mix derived from divisional summary).
